description: Source code for a web-based code editor component that integrates CodeMirror, a console, and Lua5 scripting. Defines an Editor class with methods for initialization, saving, opening, running, and stopping scripts, and includes UI pane management.

classes.name: Editor
classes.description: A class representing a code editor with Lua scripting capabilities, including methods for initialization, saving, opening, executing, and stopping scripts.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the editor, setting up CodeMirror and console components.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the current editor content to local storage with a generated name.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Opens a saved sketch from local storage and displays it in the editor.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes the code in the editor using the Lua5 VM and attaches the console.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the running VM and resets the state.

methods.name: urlSafeRandomBase64String
methods.description: Generates a URL-safe random base64 string.
